scope: All seven extension integration gaps and exact inherited 263 obligations for a versioned bounded successor profile.

tasks.title: Formalize the shared meaning, ownership, frame and coverage model
exit_criteria: Compile common definitions/proofs for exact identities, unique owner resolution, complete obligation sets and no self-seeding qualification.
Use an owner-bound condition and two-criterion requirement as the smallest formal composition; exact replacement/omission counterexamples are stated.
failure_controls: Positive caller eligibility flag with no complete qualification

tasks.title: Specify and review all 41 relation definitions and source meanings
exit_criteria: Account for all 263 IDs and retain 90 existing discharges.
Each kind has an independent satisfiable meaning, exact source refinement and declared claim tier; actual assigned owners review choices and policy ambiguity.
failure_controls: Generic effect treated as complete meaning
Same label silently merged across roles
Physical/execution truth asserted from a supplied flag

tasks.title: Prove all inherited semantic claims and mapping contracts
exit_criteria: Every one of the 263 IDs maps to exact checked statement/definitions, owner-approved interpretation and required proof or satisfiable countermodel.
Prove source mapping, qualifier agreement, effect equivalence and required closure/state invariants; no unchecked axiom hides an unresolved meaning.
Account for semantic branches over all 550 declared ordered pairs; one exemplar per kind does not establish every role-sensitive case.
failure_controls: Countermodel with no valid relation instance

tasks.title: Freeze successor schemas, APIs and proof-result contracts
exit_criteria: Closed versioned contracts bind definitions, criteria, evidence policy, exact frames, challenge inventories and allowed result states.
Derivation of mandatory obligations is owned and independent of submitted results; migration retains old opaque tokens.

tasks.title: Implement owned source catalogs and exact snapshot resolution
exit_criteria: Actual resolution matches reviewed formal contracts, including owner basis, immutable revisions and content conflict rejection.
Unresolved owner/token/time/provenance stays unresolved; no fabricated authentication fixture can become actual evidence.

tasks.title: Integrate owned expression definitions and norm activation
exit_criteria: Only the resolved AST qualifies; full origin and frame survive activation.
Unknown and conflict semantics match the reviewed policy and earlier bounded guarantees.
failure_controls: Atom versus negation under one root revision
Opposing norms with no resolution policy

tasks.title: Integrate versioned evidence and issuer/policy ownership
exit_criteria: Exact assessment revision/issuer/policy supports are retained and independently checked.
Legacy opaque-token and any-support meaning preserved; alternative policies are separately versioned.

tasks.title: Replace edge-word enumeration with proved bounded traversal
exit_criteria: Traversal agrees with bounded simple-path meaning, retains required support/unknown provenance and ancestor restrictions.
Incomplete traversal or unavailable resource enforcement cannot establish no.

tasks.title: Integrate owner-complete fulfillment and provenance
exit_criteria: The requirement revision fixes the entire criterion universe and exact frame.
All verdict rails have an independent meaning under proved well-formedness; action/output provenance and evidence policy are bound.

tasks.title: Verify byte parsing and domain semantic imports
exit_criteria: A raw-byte parse certificate or verified decoder establishes full consumption and IR denotation.
Every composed domain importer preserves exact typed source meaning; finite differential controls supplement universal proofs.

tasks.title: Implement and qualify all 41 semantic relation adapters
exit_criteria: All 41 K-units execute their source-to-typed contracts with nonvacuous actual positive and negative evidence.
All 263 inherited evidence candidates bind the correct profile/source/challenge; full completion awaits final acceptance/currentness audit.

tasks.title: Compose qualification with lifecycle and public commit
exit_criteria: Commit consumes complete current independently checked qualification and exact actual owner review.
Prove state/semantic preservation and avoid requiring the future commit receipt as its own eligibility premise.
Crash the complete public path before/after qualification, recapture, durable preparation and commit; recovery creates no new event.

tasks.title: Integrate independent checking for substantial selected proofs
exit_criteria: Independently check at least one substantial core theorem and one semantic theorem with complete anchored closures.
Expose feature/axiom/resource/disagreement states and retain mandatory Lean checks. This is an intermediate milestone.

tasks.title: Complete independent coverage of every mandatory selected closure
exit_criteria: Every mandatory theorem closure for the composed successor profile passes both required checking paths with anchored definitions.
A missing/unsupported closure blocks the whole-profile claim; selected-sample progress cannot be relabeled full coverage.

tasks.title: Implement freshness, recapture and owned evidence provenance
exit_criteria: Every claim states as-of/source completeness and its live or recorded posture.
Owner/issuer review capture or verified source adapters establish the claimed provenance; clock, cryptography and external truth premises remain explicit.

tasks.title: Measure and enforce the composed resource envelope
exit_criteria: Measure actual composed workloads and separately account for each stage and aggregate memory/time.
When a hard cap is required, exercise a real enforcement backend; cutoff/unavailability stays refusal/unknown, not a semantic negative.

tasks.title: Run the composed seven-extension pilot
exit_criteria: Expressions, assessments, delegation, fulfillment, transport and transition use one exact owner-bound frame and independently complete obligation set.
Run legitimate completion and each missing/stale/substituted/cutoff case through the public API; no stage manufactures permission or fulfillment.
failure_controls: Correct separate results from different frames

tasks.title: Audit every inherited and new integration obligation
exit_criteria: Exactly all 263 original pending IDs are discharged under their owner-reviewed scoped meanings with current evidence.
All newly derived integration obligations pass, all 90 old discharges remain valid or explicitly versioned/requalified, and no retirement/exclusion is counted as a proof.

tasks.title: Obtain actual successor meaning and use assessment
tasks.owner_role: assigned semantic owners and human use reviewer
exit_criteria: Humans review all new intended meanings, conflict/evidence policies, diagnostics and measured composed limits.
Original R06/G4 and prior P11 feedback remain their original scopes; no automatic promotion.

tasks.title: Publish the checked successor completion view
exit_criteria: Every plan task, K-unit, inherited ID and required new integration/independent closure is accepted and current.
Report exact supported profile, remaining irreducible assumptions and measured bounds; keep v1–v4 acceptance unchanged.
failure_controls: Overclaim of unbounded or external-world truth

authorization.scope: local successor implementation and candidate evidence; no deployment or authority publication
